name: n2flow
description: AI-powered flow editor with LLM integration
author: n2flow team

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix back-end install && npm --prefix front-end install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix name "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix name "npm run build:backend" "npm run build:frontend"
scripts.type-check: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix name "npm run type-check:backend" "npm run type-check:frontend"
